collection.description: A Heathen wakes certain they dreamed of a great turtle swimming slowly through the sky.

description_variants.description: An Isolan wakes certain they dreamed of a great turtle swimming slowly through the sky.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (name1) wakes before dawn certain that (he/she) has seen something in a dream: a great turtle swimming through the sky, slowly, as if it had all the time in the world. (He/she) can't shake the feeling that it meant something.

o1.name: Outcome A
o1.text: (name1) tells the story at the morning fire. Some people think it means a good season. Some think it means nothing at all. One child insists it means turtles can fly. Everybody enjoys the argument.

o2.name: Outcome B
o2.text: (name1) keeps the dream close. All day (he/she) catches (himself/herself) looking up at the sky, half expecting to see the turtle. It never appears. (He/she) feels oddly calm anyway.
